h: 这是我使用的 ComfyUi 工作流程，对于初学者来说是真正的基础。有一个用于查找 Loras 触发词的区域，因此您可以断开剪辑与模型点的连接，以便在不启动生成的情况下使用。它有一个用于 Civitai 的扳机查找器，以及一个可以扣动所有扳机的扳机查找器，以防 Lora 被移除。在我的测试过程中，我有一些 Lora 在两者上都没有显示任何内容，但那很低，所以它可能会发生。

o.en: This is my ComfyUi workflow I use, real basic for beginners. Has an area for finding trigger words for Loras so you can disconnect the Clip from the Models point just to use without starting a generation. It has a trigger finder for Civitai and one that pulls all triggers, in case the lora was removed. During my testing I had a few Lora not show anything on both but that was low so it might happen.
